scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix ../frontend run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && set ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173&& electron ."
scripts.build:backend: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location ..\backend; $work = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('nameam_noc_pyinstaller_' + $PID); .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m PyInstaller --noconfirm nameam_backend.spec --distpath dist --workpath $work"
scripts.dist: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$out = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'NameAM-NOC-Dashboard-Release'; npx electron-builder --win nsis --config.directories.output=$out"
